reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Jonathan Goldberg, the founder, and CEO of Carbon Direct.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Jonathan Goldberg, the founder, and CEO of Carbon Direct, a company focused on advising and investing in carbon removal at scale. Jonathan started his career in the commodities division of Goldman Sachs and then went on to start a commodity hedge fund, BBL Commodities. In our conversation, we cover the state of the carbon problem today, the importance of global carbon standards and carbon taxes.

key_points.text: In our conversation, we cover the state of the carbon problem today, the importance of global carbon standards and carbon taxes.
This was a masterclass on all things carbon-related.
Please enjoy my conversation with Jonathan Goldberg.
